item.title: ASMR Positive Affirmations ✨️ Reprogram Your Mind for Happiness (Thunder Soundscape)
item.description: I am happy to meet you again! Positive affirmations starting at minute 5:03. I hope you listen to this ASMR often, allowing it to gently reprogram your mind and help you feel worthy of a happy life. Take a deep breath in, allow yourself to relax and don't forget to be kind to yourself 🍃🌙💜 🎧 Use headphones for a better experience. 🪻 Free ways to support this channel: ▪︎ Like & Comment (i read and answer all) ▪︎ Subscribe & Turn on Notifications (so you don't miss a new video) ▪︎ Watch video untill the end (if you don't have YT Premium, sorry for the potential mid video ads but right now I have no control about that) #AkebiaASMR #asmr #asmrforrelaxation #asmrforsleep
